'''Nianh''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of unknown [[Ajah]] and former [[Aes Sedai advisors|advisor]] to [[Queen]] [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]] of [[Kandor]]. 

== Activities ==
She told Queen Ethenielle that the Kandori Spire was a remnant of the [[Age of Legends]] and probably harmless. 

She disappeared without a trace after news of [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]]'s deposition of [[Siuan Sanche]] and her subsequent ascension to the [[Amyrlin Seat]], either returning to [[Tar Valon]], recognizing Elaida, or joining the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] in [[Salidar]].

== Trivia ==
* Nianh is named for Nianh McAuliffe, an Irish fan of ''The Wheel of Time''. She and her friend Aisling Ryan ([[Aisling Noon]]) wrote to Robert Jordan in their final year of school, asking him to include them in his book series.
